name: Kakka to Ma no Tsuku Present!?
original_name: 閣下とマのつくプレゼント？！
source:
Yaoi adventure game. Tomorrow is the birthday of the second son (you). You'll have a nice time in the big mansion. Your boyfriend want to play hide-and seek in there with you. Can you find him?

[From [url=http://www.dlsite.com/ecchi-eng/work/=/product_id/RE025727.html]DLsite English[/url]]
translation:
矢追冒险游戏。明天是二儿子（你）的生日。你会在这座大宅子里度过一段愉快的时光。你男朋友想和你一起玩捉迷藏。你能找到他吗？

[来自[url=http://www.dlsite.com/ecchi-eng/work/=/product_id/RE025727.html]DLsite英文[/url]]
